question.text: The clearing member settlement pool account is maintained with:

answer.text: Both depositories - CDSL and NSDL through depository participants

explanation.text: The Logic: Clearing members must open demat accounts with both depositories — CDSL and NSDL — through depository participants. These are the clearing member settlement pool accounts. The Trap: Holding with only one depository, or directly with the CC, does not match the source requirement. Note: The dual-depository requirement is stated in the source for clearing member settlement pool accounts.
